notes.title: We’re exhibiting at Tokyo Game Show 2025, September 25–28!
notes.notes:
[p][b]We’re exhibiting at Tokyo Game Show 2025, September 25–28![/b]
📍 Booth: Hall 11-E34 (Indie Game Corner) ✨[/p][p]You’ll be able to [b]try out the game[/b] on-site, and we’ll also be screening the newly released [b]main story opening movie[/b]![/p][p]Plus, the [b]first 100 visitors each day[/b] will receive an exclusive, newly illustrated postcard as a gift.
We look forward to seeing you there![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45249924/21bce1b910b30de38ce7fc4d6d9b58924d677208.png"][/img][/p]
